generations.text: Nadia Lindqvist contacted support because the Aero 2 stops charging after a few minutes since 2026-05-08. It is a Medium priority case and the status is currently Closed. The agent offered a refund of $149.50. The customer confirmed order ORD-92721 and asked for a callback. The knowledge base notes that Pulse Band syncs only over Bluetooth 5 or later. The tone of the thread is polite but increasingly impatient.
